description.value: Newton Pizza is a local pizza chain with several locations across the Surrey and North Delta area of British Columbia, built on a reputation for fresh ingredients and house-perfected recipes. The Surrey/North Delta outlet on 128 Street serves the surrounding community with dine-in and online ordering. Touring cyclists passing through the area will find it a straightforward stop for a quick hot meal.
